decision.reference: Authorization bead bu-t53498 for implementation bead bu-jv1moa.18 (the Home Safety Sentinel job debounces on last_changed, falling back to last_updated, and gives active safety alarms a faster re-escalation ladder, with guarded _confirm_episode metadata branches). Reviewed before: main 7cbcbfa13faa1fbe593d6a0fbb57555adeeed888 as recorded in bu-jv1moa.18 (sec-review-lane local verdict CLEAN after the N2 recheck, pre-manifest v3; the formal review bead opens with the DRAFT PR while GitHub access is suspended); approved subject: agent/bu-jv1moa.18 head 9a5a3c729da7bd2c1e53989903ba551205cfc44b plus the reviewer-computed request. Governing requirement REQ-home-deterministic-jobs-001 (Home Safety Sentinel Job) in openspec/specs/home-deterministic-jobs/spec.md, whose ID-only header lands in this same change ahead of the manifest. The 30 owners in tests/jobs/test_home_safety_sentinel.py are setup or context only: the module-level _make_schema helper adds the nullable last_changed column that home_005 adds in production; test bodies and assertions are unchanged. This exact manifest requires its own independent review and protected-main publication before consumption; provenance text grants no runtime admission.
